label: Pipedrive
description: Find, create, and update deals, people, organizations, leads, activities, and notes in one Pipedrive company.
securityDescription: Pipedrive connects with an API key and company subdomain entered on Composio's hosted page; Chickpea never receives the key. Agents act as the Pipedrive user who owns the key. With write access, Agents can create and update deals, people, organizations, leads, and activities, and add and edit notes. People are saved without email addresses or marketing consent, and an update cannot change a person's phone numbers. Agents cannot delete or merge records, change who owns a record or who can see it, add products to deals, manage pipelines, stages, users, roles, permissions, or webhooks, or send email.

drop.PIPEDRIVE_ADD_PRODUCT: Changes the shared product catalog, which is outside the deal, person, organization, and activity records this connector edits.
drop.PIPEDRIVE_DEALS_UPDATE_DEAL: Changes product pricing and quantities attached to a deal; deal products stay a person's change.
drop.PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_DEAL: Duplicates PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL_V2 on the older API.
drop.PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_PERSON: Duplicates PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_PERSON_V2 on the older API.

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_PERSON.marketing_status: Records marketing consent, which lets Pipedrive Campaigns email the person.

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_PERSON_V2.marketing_status: Records marketing consent, which lets Pipedrive Campaigns email the person.

include_fields.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default

organization_id.description: Will filter deals by the provided organization ID. The upper limit of found deals associated with the organization is 2000.

capabilities.description: Tool to update a person's properties in Pipedrive using the v2 API. Use when you need to modify existing person details such as name, contact information, owner, or organization.
